text.p: These are the leading stories in the Lebanese press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Pro-opposition Labour leader Abu Rizk is under arrest in hospital.
- Maronite Patriarch Sfeir criticises the abuse of laws to violate freedoms in Lebanon.
- Israel said a one-party withdrawal from Lebanon is not possible now.
- Saudi Prince Walid Bin Talal offers three planes to evacuate Lebanese nationals from Sierra Leone.
- Central Bank Governor Salameh said: "The rise in the budget deficit will halt the decrease of interest rates".
- Israeli troops detained eight Lebanese citizens north of the south Lebanon occupation zone.
- 255 Lebanese nationals arrive in Beirut today from Freetown on Middle East Airlines carrier.
- Three rounds of Israeli air raids on south Lebanon.
